Keep it empty. The gate fails for any text tenant_id table that is not listed
here, so a new entry is the visible cost of introducing a tenant-owned table
without referential integrity. Adding one is a decision, not a formality:
prefer a uuid column with a validated FK from the start.
Note for anyone re-running 100's pattern: these tables are FORCE ROW LEVEL
SECURITY, so an FK validation scan must lift FORCE on the child AND on tenants.
With FORCE left on, VALIDATE either sees no rows and succeeds without checking
anything, or sees no parent rows and fails claiming every tenant is missing.
